admission.justification: These two routes serve full blobs and can avoid a second complete allocation while preserving their consumer contracts.

applicability: Native whole-object Git transport for changed-history evidence and Explainer grade refresh.
conditions: Consume the owned spool within the read lifetime and retain the route's exact bytes and typed failure behavior.
History evidence validates its own blob header and body length. Grade refresh reads a successful Git blob body.
exclusions: Bounded evidence windows keep their separate line- and byte-limit transport contract.
The contract concerns duplicate transport allocation. The selected body can still be retained by its caller.

evidence: bug-r18-W2-expanded-evidence.md, L18-F03 and the admitted grade-refresh census repair.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: The native Explainer changed-history and grade-refresh readers deliver exact blob bytes from private spools without retaining a duplicate transport body.
